why: A declared status may be a single value or a LIST of acceptable ones.
Service and live cases declare ["Passed","Blocked"]: the invariant held, or a source was unreachable and nothing was measured. What no list contains is Failed.
mini-cex cases (DB, API, FE) are deterministic against the local service and its SQLite; they grade Blocked only when the service is not running or the browser is unavailable.
Kraken cases grade Blocked when the public API is unreachable, rate-limited, or serves a challenge page -- an outage is never a broken exchange.
The pure risk-gate cases (bot) touch no source, so they are declared Passed outright.
No case is declared Failed: nothing here is currently failing, and manufacturing a failure to have one would be dishonest.

summary.note: nominal: mini-cex running and seeded, Kraken reachable, a browser available for the FE tier
